parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Talkset.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` — carry `is_test: true` and reside in the `PlaylistTesting` source group of the `Playlist` package. Stub factory methods for distinct domain types (`Playcut` vs. `Talkset`) are intentionally parallel in shape; their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) reflects the conventional pattern of test-fixture builders, not accidental duplication. Merging or abstracting them would couple unrelated test-support types and obscure the intent of each stub.
